answer: The lagoon cap is policed at intake and meadow shows the per-origin counts. At most 2 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a harbor tag. A datacenter or proxy pool thus cannot mint a swarm in one epoch regardless of capital it holds, as each identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The deposit is 87 dollars a seat. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
